name: research116_prospective_three_rule_deepseek
retrospective_task_selection: Known OP repair task and initial partial BRANCH baseline. Future model outputs are not selected or filtered after observation. Not a new historical bug sample.
first_proposal: One fresh shared response from original partial BRANCH baseline. No research113 successful property or any holdout outcome in requests.

arms.O: R0: current9 sampling/trigger/all-property + search36 acceptance; history is measurement only.
arms.H: R0 plus absolute full151: native healthy, zero false alarms/misses/critical unknown and complete required triggers.
arms.R: R0 plus existing obligation-preservation gate and all-property history guard; same151 evidence and same strict full scope.

contrasts: Paired first-proposal decision effect separately from independently sampled second-round policy outcomes. H/R receive exactly the same historical facts and message construction; decision rules alone differ.
comparator_overlap: R already includes full absolute acceptance. On complete identity-preserving fixed evidence H/R may be equivalent. Agreement is not relative-comparator gain. No weakening H to force discrimination.
feedback: O only current9/search36 raw diagnostics. H/R same current9/search36/history115 diagnostics. No arm names, hidden gate results, other responses or independent outcomes in prompts.
stopping: Maximum4 physical calls:1 shared and at most1 separate continuation for each rejected O/H/R. Accepting arm stops; transport failure stops all. No retry, fallback, quota transfer or extra seed. A non-discriminating/negative pilot is a completed result and stops expansion.
qualification: Baseline executes, has real public OP gap and270 BRANCH protections. Native positive/negative decision controls pass. This is preflight, not successful model generation.
terminal: All arms stop and freeze before one fresh96-word four-config test batch. Only run holdout if at least one arm accepts; failed/fallback arms remain in denominator. Same words do not become independent samples by being replayed for3 arms.
expansion_gate: All arms complete without infrastructure error; shared fresh proposal ordinary-accepts but a historical rule extra-rejects; that SAME rejected historical arm subsequently accepts within2 logical calls and passes new independent tests. Otherwise stop, keep negative/non-discriminating result. Passing does NOT authorize expansion.
scope: One prospective pilot on known task; no stable generation or recovery rate, no formal proof. Old research93 tests protected and not used to tune rules.
common_generation: Qualified research103/113 text-expression+sample-bound pair/temporal presentation. All arms identical frontend, fixed BRANCH, model, temperature0.2/max_tokens1024; no extra plan gate. Only allowed evidence differs by rule after shared proposal.
information: First all public current9/search36; O continuation sees only those. H/R receive identical current9/search36/history115 facts via same builder, independently called. Full native history measured for all but never fed to O.
score: Shared-proposal paired acceptance contrast; then separate independent continuation outcomes. Same seeds do not couple independent service samples. One selected known task, no population recovery rate.
privacy: research113 input words used only for collision exclusion after task selection; outcomes and accepted assertions hash-protected but not parsed. No new test generated before all terminal versions.
rule_status: R includes strict absolute acceptance on this fixed identity-preserving corpus. H/R may be equivalent. Do not weaken H or interpret stochastic continuation differences as unique relative-gate benefit.
future: No automatic multiseed calls. Only a shared O-accepted/H-or-R-extra-rejected proposal followed by same-arm bounded recovery and fresh independent pass qualifies for a separately sealed replication request.
